title: Compile the signed Gaussian atlas with exact quadratic sums and lower fixed setup
body:
The complete fixed installation of the seven-stage signed multiplier now generates its Gaussian chart atlas in polynomial space in the circuit size. For the actual graph, full initialization of both suppliers fell from a mean of **82.20 seconds to 5.20 seconds** across two fresh processes per version. The serial fixed-tape setup ceiling falls from **2^513 to 2^241 transitions**. The latter comparison includes a sharper tape lookup bound. The elapsed comparison measures the actual code. [Construction and proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc21f7040cb3376709b30fc42f289827836d8be5/research/quadratic-native-installation/PROOF.md) · [Tape and movement bill](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc21f7040cb3376709b30fc42f289827836d8be5/research/quadratic-native-installation/COST.md) · [Measurements and limits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc21f7040cb3376709b30fc42f289827836d8be5/research/quadratic-native-installation/EVIDENCE.json)

An exact binary quadratic sum recovers the absolute phase of every chart circuit. The 2,971 paid charts and both sides of the 104 ports reproduce the pinned atlas byte for byte. One copy of the native helper and return descriptions serves 48 chronological calls. This reduces 334,176 stored role records to 25,621 plus 145 segment descriptors. Each call still emits its original paid and productive labels. The added label work fits the recurring clock. [Production compiler](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc21f7040cb3376709b30fc42f289827836d8be5/research/quadratic-native-installation/phase_atlas.py) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc21f7040cb3376709b30fc42f289827836d8be5/research/quadratic-native-installation/SOURCES.json)

The construction retains the seven-stage source's conditional κ = 0.003890115286594445, largest binary log rank 95,600,000,000,000,000, numerical log rank 19,000, activation exponent 101,973,332,976,357,367 and log₂ C ceiling 1,670,731,087,109,379,198,659. At initial publication the strongest competing κ was 0.003890115286594461 in [PR #8050](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8050). The inherited research premises cover the all-column native action, owned erasure, compiler transfer, precision/tape service and analytic recovery. Production-scale execution and crossover remain open.

The registered replay checks 16,368 independently computed circuit entries, all signed charts and phases, and rejection of a wrong global phase. Two nonzero raw witnesses traverse all 564,144 paid calls and return all 105,216 owners. A separate finite signed Fourier product returns −345550037539 and the five expected coefficients. Lean 4.34.1 and leanchecker verify the gate normalization and two finite-sum eliminations, with propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The full compiler and tape clock have written proofs. [Formal statements](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc21f7040cb3376709b30fc42f289827836d8be5/research/quadratic-native-installation/PhaseSum.lean)

Run with CPython 3.12, assertions enabled and Git on PATH.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/quadratic-native-installation
```

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/quadratic-native-installation outcome=completed
```

Canonical base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Ali Romman’s [PR #8042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8042) supplies the frozen physical machine at `dfd25d553a843a946ca0b94130a5ff8943e98fdd`. The P104 numerical word, grade-14 charts, original tableau checker and general quadratic-form methods retain their predecessor credit. Clear1nsight supplies the live endpoint comparison. This contribution used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. [Attribution](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cc21f7040cb3376709b30fc42f289827836d8be5/research/quadratic-native-installation/NOTICE.md)

The head includes the previously published [PR #7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) repair for the canonical CI guide and the historical selected snapshot. The three hosted jobs pass. SYLforge has since submitted a higher complete comparison of κ = 0.003898171 in [PR #8052](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8052).
